capabilities: create databases with two-way relations, formulas, and rollups
visualize notes as lists, tables, calendars, and boards
filter, sort, and group note views
build custom dashboards, trackers, and workspaces without code
organize notes into categories to reduce clutter
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a Markdown editing tool; its core job is code-free databases, views, and workspaces.
extras: The README says Flow Blocks and Flow Styler (Markdown editing and editable embeds) remain part of Make.md Basics but will soon split into their own plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to organize notes into databases and visual views without code or third-party dependencies.

relations.evidence: Parts of the Flow Editor is based on Hover Editor
Dataview syncing adapted with the help of Metadata Menu
Dataview syncing adapted with the help of Metadata Menu

summary: Code-free organization toolkit that adds databases with two-way relations, formulas, rollups, and visual list, table, calendar, and board views over notes.
